steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Musical theatre combines drama, music and dance — songs advance the plot and reveal character, not just provide entertainment.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Leitmotifs (recurring musical themes) represent characters, places or ideas — used extensively in musicals to create associations.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Broadway orchestration combines classical instruments with rhythm section and amplification — the pit orchestra balances with sung text.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Singing styles: belt (powerful chest voice for emotional climaxes), legit (classical head voice for lyrical moments), mix (blend of both for versatility).

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Always use PRECISE musical vocabulary — not vague descriptions like it sounds nice Reference SPECIFIC musical elements when analysing any piece For listening questions: identify elements FIRST, then explain their effect For study pieces: know the context, structure and key features in detail For performing: focus on accuracy, expression and interpretation For composing: show development of ideas, not just repetition
